title: MiniGPT-4: Enhancing Vision-Language Understanding with Advanced Large Language Models
layout_note: A bottom-to-top stack: the input drawing sits bottom-right and feeds a 'Q-Former & ViT' block bottom-centre, a single orange 'Linear Layer' box above it, then a full-width 'Vicuna' bar; the prompt pieces sit in dashed bubbles either side of the Linear Layer, and the generated answer is a large dashed speech bubble across the top.
grouping: No containers: the three model parts are separate solid boxes stacked vertically; the text inputs ('### Human:' and the question with '### Assistant:') and the output paragraph are green dashed rounded bubbles, so all text is grouped by the dashed-green style and all modules by the solid style.
shapes_depth: Flat rectangles with thick dark outlines: frozen parts filled mid blue with a white snowflake icon, the trainable Linear Layer filled orange with rounded corners; a small llama picture sits in the Vicuna bar. Thick green arrows join everything. The output paragraph is grey text with key phrases set in bold magenta.
proposed_highlight: The only trainable part, the Linear Layer, is the one orange box among blue frozen boxes (frozen ones carry a snowflake); the answer's descriptive phrases are bolded in magenta to show the generation quality.
lesson: When a model adds one trainable piece between two frozen giants, make it the single warm-coloured box in a stack of cool frozen ones and mark the frozen ones with a snowflake glyph.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2304.10592); first page says 'Preprint'; remembered venue ICLR 2024 (not verified in this session). The input image is a line drawing of a flamingo logo rendered as a picture.

arrangement.units: one unframed vertical stack: vision block, Linear Layer, Vicuna bar, with dashed text bubbles around it
arrangement.inputs_as: the image (a pink flamingo logo drawing) at the bottom right; the prompt as quoted text in green dashed bubbles at the Vicuna bar's lower edge
arrangement.losses_at: no loss drawn; the generated answer is a quoted paragraph in a dashed bubble at the top

insights.structure: Three solid module boxes are stacked bottom-to-top (Q-Former & ViT, Linear Layer, a full-width Vicuna bar) with the text prompt pieces as dashed bubbles flanking the Linear Layer just under the LLM bar.
insights.data: The prompt and the answer are drawn as real quoted text in green dashed rounded bubbles, the answer as a long paragraph whose key phrases are bold magenta, and the image enters as a picture from the bottom right.
insights.emphasis: Colour encodes trainability: the Linear Layer is the lone orange box while every frozen part is blue with a white snowflake.
insights.flow: Read from the bottom up: thick green arrows run picture -> vision block -> Linear Layer -> Vicuna, the side bubbles feed Vicuna from below, and one arrow at the right end of Vicuna rises into the answer bubble.
insights.avoid: The answer paragraph takes about a third of the figure and the input image sits outside any frame, so the model itself is visually smaller than its example output.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
